name: wb-spell
description: wb-spell — a quality-gated implementation pipeline for Claude Code. /WBspell drives the whole thing from an issue: Research (parallel multi-lens scouts, evidence-verified) -> Plan -> Critique (red-team the plan, re-plan on blockers) -> Implement (parallel units) -> Review (rewrite until tests pass and the score clears the gate) -> Commit — pausing at human checkpoints. Stages are independent skills handing off through markdown artifacts in .wb/.
